description: Adjacent ML researcher: knows general ML, deep learning, standard evaluation practice and statistics, but not this project's subfield-specific terminology (TinyML, MCU, DSP, edge inference), datasets (Speech Commands, VWW, ToyADMOS), or prior work in embedded ML benchmarking.
assumed_knowledge: Supervised learning, classification, standard metrics (top-1 accuracy, AUC-ROC)
needs_explanation: TinyML: what it is, why sub-mW matters
Why energy is a first-class metric (wireless comm cost > compute cost at this scale)
Hardware heterogeneity in embedded systems (no standard clock, no OS, no debug)
AUC-ROC as threshold-free metric for anomaly detection
Device Under Test (DUT) and measurement harness setup
Inferences per second (IPS) as a latency proxy
term_budget: moderate (explain each new concept once, use consistently)
personas: ML researcher reading NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks track
Systems ML researcher exploring edge deployment
